thesis: Faith may motivate, interpret or obstruct investigation; convictions alone do not determine which role it plays.

ideas.statement: Faraday and Ampère need careful quotations, Maxwell warned against institutional harmonization, and Crookes’ spiritualist research requires controls beyond personal conviction.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Authentic motivation would not establish a sole cause of discovery; sincere observers can jointly err, and unverified personal stories are not certified facts.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Authentic motivation would not establish a sole cause of discovery; sincere observers can jointly err, and unverified personal stories are not certified facts.

audit.notes: All batch units analyzed directly; uncertainty and counterexamples retained.
